Read each result by feature, source profile and test phase: nag reduction is not FSD activation, correct AP display is not correct hardware identification, and finite success is not universal reliability. The tracker body’s blanket server-derived tier/off-CAN conclusions exceed the additive-replay observation in issue117 and remain upstream interpretations. Its later referenced content-specific preflight study is a separate tested setup, not modern receiver code recovered here. Claims that a handler replaces originals, that a diagnostic bus hint identifies the network, or that unchanged torque shape excludes timing/acceptance problems are not adopted without matching proof. Final black-box submission evidence is requested, not delivered in this thread.

The positive refreshed-platform HW3 result must be retained alongside its later regression. It does not prove a universal modern compatibility claim or identify the 0x331 consumer. Asynchronous gateway processing, entitlement-cache expiry, downloaded model-weight availability and reboot causation are maintainer explanations without recovered matching receiver proof. The thread repeatedly corrects wiring, MCU generation and Legacy/HW3 classification, so early advice cannot be reused timelessly. A crash fix, TX counter, temporary UI option, visualization and actual control each require a separate outcome label.

This thread supports setup-specific observed successes and failures, plus important reversals of bus identity, state layout, capture attribution and configuration advice. It does not recover a universal preflight algorithm or prove that every HW4 tap requires the same bus. Dashboard readiness, handler modifications, submitted traffic, nag suppression and maintained control are distinct outcomes. Error-limited or short captures cannot establish generation-wide ID absence; third-party device efficacy and causal mechanisms remain reported rather than independently verified.

The thread supplies actual reported HW3 activation and residual failures, plus unusually important corrections to capture origin and firmware-port behavior. RX equality cannot stand in for TX equality. State and steering correlation do not prove an internal planner cause, and a clean AP-only run is not the same-mode counterfactual for injected FSD. Timing, enum labels, road context, firmware path and actual emitted payload must stay attached to each result. No claim here proves current HW4 acceptance, a universal safe activation method, or a solved narrow-road fault.

The configuration rewrite is a valuable platform-specific positive lead. Available older APE decoders assign a different scalar meaning to the same numeric 0x331 ID on their routed input, so physical bus, source schema and consumer remain the missing link; the reported success must not be dismissed or generalized. A locally already-matching input yields no Restore transformation and is not the same intervention. Distinguish UI restoration, actual traffic-control behavior, full FSD activation and reversal of backend restrictions. No current HW4 receiver, universal preflight algorithm or reliable enforcement-prevention mechanism is established by this thread.
